blocks.text: Sulfonamides sulfanilamide se bane masnooi compounds hain; kitab in ki daryaft Gerhard Domagk (1932) se jorti hai. Yeh zyada tar peshab ki nali aur jild ke bacterial infections ka ilaaj bacteria mein folic acid banna rok kar karti hain, jo DNA banne aur barhotri ke liye zaroori hai. Yeh competitive inhibitors ke taur par kaam karti aur bacteriostatic hain. Aam taur par munh se li jati hain; zimni asraat mein daane, matli, roshni se hassasiyat aur gurde ka nuqsan shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Normal: PABA bacterial enzyme ki jagah mein fit hota hai, teer 'folic acid made' tak, phir 'DNA, growth'. Sulfonamide: sulfonamide wahi jagah le leti hai, teer 'no folic acid' tak, phir 'growth stops'.
blocks.caption: Sulfonamide PABA se enzyme ki jagah ke liye muqabla (competitive inhibition) karti hai (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

items: Bacteriostatic: yeh bacteria ko foran nahi maarti balke un ki barhotri rokti hain, taa ke immune system unhein khatam kare.
Selective toxicity: bacteria ko folate khud banana parta hai jab ke insan ise khane se jazb karte hain, is liye dawa bacteria ko zaroori ghizai juz se mehroom karti aur insani cells ko chhorti hai.
Competitive inhibition: para-aminobenzoic acid (PABA) se milti julti hone ki wajah se yeh us bacterial enzyme se jurti hain jo PABA se folate banata hai, aur raasta band karti hain.
Mila jula ilaaj: zyada taqatwar, bactericidal asar ke liye inhein aksar trimethoprim ke saath milaya jata hai.
Wasee daira: yeh Gram-positive aur Gram-negative bacteria par kaam karti aur peshab ki nali ke infections, keel muhason aur saans ke infections mein use hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Sulfonamides sirf bacteria ke liye zehreeli kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Bacteria ko PABA se folate banana parta hai, yahi qadam dawa rokti hai; insani cells folate khane se lete aur yeh raasta use nahi karte.

items: PABA se muqabla kar ke folate banna rokti; aksar trimethoprim ke saath.
